test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people Tanu, Rano, Beena, Shirin, Kanak, Aditya and Anshul are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of Tanu. Only three people sit between Tanu and Rano. Beena sits second to the right of Shirin. Beena is an immediate neighbour of Rano. Kanak sits to the immediate right of Aditya.

Who sits at the extreme right end of the row?
solution:
Given: Seven people Tanu, Rano, Beena, Shirin, Kanak, Aditya and Anshul are sitting in a straight row, facing north. 

1) Only two people sit to the left of Tanu.

2) Only three people sit between Tanu and Rano. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5241fd9e5f37fc4e00cb82e8816707344b6f643af388139a9ab0bc23293920e2.png] 

3) Beena sits second to the right of Shirin.

4) Beena is an immediate Neighbour of Rano.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b87792b9c4f85398243d5822e2de3b7e9caf5e1a9d2a06594413a0cbefe3459f.png] 

5) Kanak sits to the immediate right of Aditya.

6) And, Anshul will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9063eb267090873635555b337d0c3084336d62dad57325ab1f2994f21a80d33.png] 

Thus, Rano sits at the extreme right end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
